item.title: Bitcoin Holds Steady Near $78,727 as U.S. Government Moves BTC
item.summary: BTC/USD closed at $78,727.438 at 22:00 UTC on August 26, up +0.220493% over 24 hours per Alpaca, as a small U.S. government BTC transfer, CLARITY Act discussion, and Pakistan's new crypto framework populated the news cycle.
